title: Either: errors as values
hints: README 'New syntax': `case readMaybe s of` with guards for parseAge, a `do` block for canEnter, `mapM` for parseAll.

parseAge: no number → Left (NotANumber s); otherwise check < 0, then > 150, else Right n. canEnter: get the age with `<-`, then `pure` one of the two messages. parseAll: run parseAge over the whole list; the first error wins.
Other data: `parseNum` and `doubled` in the README · `mapM parseNum ["1", "x"]` → Left "not a number: x".
`canEnter s = do { age <- parseAge s; pure (if age >= 18 then "welcome" else "too young") }` · `parseAll xs = mapM parseAge xs`.
